question:
Consider the statements on PRITHvi Vigyan Mission:

1. Integrates earth system observations.

2. Strengthens disaster early warning systems.

3. Implemented by Health Ministry.

Which are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **PRITHvi (Program for Resilient Infrastructure & Transformation for the Health of the earth) Vigyan Mission** aims to integrate earth system observations to provide a comprehensive understanding of climate and environmental changes.
 
• The mission is focused on strengthening **disaster early warning systems**, ensuring preparedness for natural hazards like cyclones, floods, droughts, and earthquakes.
 
• It is implemented under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES)**, not the Health Ministry, as it pertains to earth sciences and disaster management.
 
• The mission primarily emphasizes **multi-disciplinary research** in earth sciences to address environmental challenges and enhance forecasting capabilities.
 
• By combining advanced technology and scientific research, PRITHvi Vigyan Mission supports the development of sustainable solutions for climate resilience and disaster management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Statement 3 is incorrect:**

 
 
• The PRITHvi Vigyan Mission is implemented by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, not the Health Ministry.
 
• The Health Ministry primarily focuses on healthcare initiatives, while this mission pertains to earth science research and disaster preparedness.
 
 
 
• **Key Objectives of the PRITHvi Vigyan Mission:**
 
 
• To integrate earth system observations for a holistic understanding of the planet.
 
• To strengthen disaster early warning systems and improve climate adaptation measures.
 
• To enhance forecasting capabilities for weather, climate, and natural hazards.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Disaster Early Warning Systems:**
 
 
• Early warning systems help in mitigating the impact of natural disasters by providing timely and accurate information.
 
• They play a crucial role in reducing loss of life, property damage, and economic losses.
 
• PRITHvi Vigyan Mission works towards enhancing these systems through advanced research and integration of data.
 
 
 
• **Earth System Science:**
 
 
• Earth system science is a multidisciplinary field that studies the interactions between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere.
 
• It involves advanced research to understand natural phenomena and their impact on the environment.
 
• PRITHvi Vigyan Mission aligns with this field to address global challenges like climate change and disaster resilience.
